description: This Java class defines a BroadcastReceiver called MessagingReceiver that listens for incoming SMS and MMS messages, handling different actions depending on Android OS version and messaging app status. It delegates the processing to a MessagingService.

classes.name: MessagingReceiver
classes.description: A WakefulBroadcastReceiver that processes incoming SMS and MMS messages, starting a service to handle each message type.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles broadcast intents for SMS/MMS messages, delegating processing based on message type and Android version.

methods.name: handleIncomingSms
methods.description: Starts the MessagingService with an action to process incoming SMS messages.

methods.name: handleIncomingMms
methods.description: Starts the MessagingService with an action to process incoming MMS messages.
